text.title: Content Refresh SOP Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from the evergreen inventory to re-evaluated refreshes: write the thresholds and windows, filter eligible URLs, build the GSC plus GA4 plus rank dataset for both windows, compute the three signals and assign one verdict per URL, then execute consolidate with redirects, kill with 410, or refresh through the nine-step checklist with baseline and day-90 re-score, and validate the playbook step.

step.name: write-thresholds-and-windows
step.input: The site's seasonality; how far back the persisted Search Console export reaches.
step.action: In `templates/content-refresh-sop.playbook-step.md.j2` set `thresholds` (`impressions_trend_pct`, `position_decay_positions`, `intent_shift_query_mix_pct`), `window` with equal `trailing_days` and `prior_days`, `span_months` and `source`, and `decision_branches` mapping each signal's threshold to a verdict.
step.decision-gate: Span over 16 months with `source: search_console_ui`: the comparison is 12 months against 4; switch to the persisted export (r-one-dataset-gsc-ga4-rank, r-three-signals-with-thresholds).

step.name: filter-eligible-urls
step.input: The content inventory with content type and publish date.
step.action: Keep URLs tagged evergreen with `url_age_months` at least 12; leave news, release notes, dated announcements and campaign pages out of the queue regardless of decline.
step.decision-gate: A URL is under 12 months or not evergreen: it is not scored (06-decision-tree.xml, r-eligibility-evergreen-12-months).

step.name: build-the-three-source-dataset
step.input: Search Console export (clicks, impressions, average position by page), GA4 landing-page report (sessions, key events), rank tracker (target query position), for the trailing and prior windows.
step.action: Fill `dataset.trailing` and `dataset.prior` with `gsc`, `ga4` and `rank` for every URL.
step.decision-gate: Any source is missing for a URL: do not score it; complete the dataset first (r-one-dataset-gsc-ga4-rank).

step.name: compute-signals-and-assign-one-verdict
step.action: Set `signals.impressions_trend_pct` = (trailing - prior) / prior x 100, `signals.position_decay_positions` = trailing avg_position - prior avg_position, and `signals.intent_shift` with a note on query mix and SERP features. Assign exactly one `verdict`; for `leave` record `reason` and `next_review_at`.
step.decision-gate: An intent shift routes to kill or leave, never refresh; a URL tagged "later" is rejected (r-three-signals-with-thresholds, r-four-verdicts-exhaustive).

step.name: execute-consolidate
step.action: Name `survivor_url`, list `merged_urls`, add one 301 or 308 in `redirects[]` from each merged URL to the survivor, rewrite every internal link that pointed at a merged URL (`internal_links_rewritten: true`), record the 28-day `baseline` on publication and `reevaluation_at` 90 days later.
step.decision-gate: A merged URL without a redirect: the sources are not deleted until it has one (r-consolidate-301-to-survivor).

step.name: execute-kill
step.action: Return 410 (404 acceptable), remove the URL from the XML sitemap and navigation, drop inbound internal links, `redirect_target: null`.
step.decision-gate: An equivalent page exists: the verdict was consolidate; a redirect to the homepage is a soft 404 and is rejected (r-kill-returns-410-never-homepage).

step.name: execute-refresh-through-the-nine-steps
step.input: Rows with `verdict: refresh`; the top-ranking pages for the target query.
step.action: Keep the URL. Run the nine `checklist[]` steps in order, recording an `exit_criterion` and `done` for each (a skipped step gets `skipped_reason`): query and intent research; facts and dates with sources; title, meta and intro; missing sections; media; internal links in and out; technical fixes; `dateModified` and changelog; re-index request and baseline. Set `substantive_change`, `date_modified_updated`, `title_changed_for_intent`, the 28-day `baseline` and `reevaluation_at` = published_at + 90 days.
step.decision-gate: Only the intro and the date changed: `substantive_change` is false and `dateModified` stays; a new slug turns the refresh into a migration and is rejected (r-refresh-keeps-url-honest-date, r-nine-step-checklist-complete).

step.name: validate-and-schedule-the-day-90-rescore
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-content-refresh-sop.py --file`. Put every `reevaluation_at` in the calendar; on that day re-score the URL against its baseline with the same thresholds.
step.output: Validated playbook step; day-90 re-evaluations scheduled.
step.decision-gate: A refresh or consolidate has no baseline: it cannot be called a success or a failure; record the baseline before closing (r-baseline-and-90-day-reevaluation).

list.item: Playbook step validates via `scripts/validate-content-refresh-sop.py` with no violation.
Every eligible URL has one verdict; every refresh has nine checklist exit criteria, an unchanged URL and a baseline; every consolidate has its redirect map; every kill returns 410 with no redirect.
Every refresh and consolidate has a day-90 re-evaluation date 90 days after publication.
